commitThreshold: edge-to-edge passage with settled pressure; same-edge, short, or unsettled paths refuse
primitiveBudget: one continuous asymmetrical membrane, thirty-two contour nodes, seven embedded seams, four liftable pressure crossings
memoryRule: a settled crossing re-produces every node and seam along its pressure vector; passage order changes the next drying state and lift restores the prior skin
interactionRule: pointer or touch crosses from one edge to another and settles before release; Enter/Space performs a deterministic crossing; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases; S saves
representationRupture: radial ring, relief ribs, and vacancy plates -> one continuous pigment membrane with embedded drying seams
compositionRupture: centred segmented bodies and distributed registers -> one broad asymmetrical skin with no cells or apertures
encounterRupture: timed pulse, reversible lift, and discrete cut -> continuous edge-to-edge crossing with pressure settling
temporalRupture: phase gate and vacancy memory -> ordered drying memory that globally re-produces the next skin
mediumRupture: radial segments, relief plates, and planar cells -> generated Canvas 2D membrane, contour, seam paths, and pressure shadow
changedRule: Pressure is not a mark. A settled edge-to-edge passage re-produces the entire continuous membrane along its direction and becomes part of the next drying state.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one continuous asymmetrical pigment skin. A valid passage bends every contour node and embedded seam; four crossings persist and reverse order produces a different membrane.
falsifier: Delete if a same-edge, short, or unsettled passage commits, if only local colour or readout changes, if the whole membrane does not move, if order is cosmetic, or if lift is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v053 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish a drying membrane from a decorated field, v050 relief, or v052 vacancy register.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
